essence: The Sudarshana discus derives its sacred status from having been bestowed upon Vishnu by the speaker.
The lord of Lanka demonstrated extraordinary devotion by worshipping the discus for a thousand years.
The discus is empowered by a specific nine-syllabled mantra.
The ritual invocation of the discus employs distinct mantra endings and epithets applied individually.
The practitioner secures the eastern direction by ritually binding it with the discus and its associated mantra.
